fullPassage: You may have never heard of coltan, a kind of mineral found mostly in Africa. However, it contains tantalum, a rare metal that is probably a big part of your life. Tantalum is used to make tantalum capacitors, which are an essential component of cameras, laptops, and cell phones. Not surprisingly, this makes tantalum highly valuable―so valuable, in fact, that a terrible conflict is being fought over it. About 80% of the world’s coltan is found in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Currently, the country is in the middle of a violent armed conflict, and most of its coltan mines are controlled by military groups. They extract the coltan and sell it to neighboring countries, using the money to buy more weapons. More and more people are buying electronic devices containing tantalum each year. To meet this demand, large amounts of coltan must be dug out of the earth. In many cases, small children are forced to work in the mines. Many farmers, whose fields have been destroyed in the fighting, are also employed by these mines. Although they receive a fair wage, they are often robbed of their pay by armed soldiers. But humans aren’t the only ones being negatively affected. Wildlife in the area is also suffering. Endangered gorillas live in the area where coltan is mined, and they are often killed in the process of mining. The eastern region of the Congo was once home to thousands of eastern lowland gorillas; although the current population is unknown, it is believed to have been reduced by more than 50%. The conflict in the Congo is a complicated situation without an easy solution. However, businesses can improve the situation by refusing to buy any coltan coming from military groups. Moreover, within the Congo, they can work to support legitimate coltan mines, making sure the profits are used to benefit communities. Individuals can also help. By keeping our old electronic devices rather than buying new ones each year, we can reduce the demand for coltan. Then when we do upgrade to a newer model, we can recycle the old one or give it to charity instead of throwing it in the trash. Even the smallest efforts, when made by millions of consumers, can make a difference.

④ a useless part: 쓸모없는 부품 — 필수적이라는 흐름과 반대예요

→ 고릴라가 '죽임을 당하는' 대상이라 수동의 과거분사가 필요해요.

→ 동사 kill을 과거분사 killed로 바꿔요.
det.tip: are often killed = 자주 죽임을 당하다 (수동태).

questions.passage: You may have never heard of coltan, a kind of mineral found mostly in Africa. However, it contains tantalum, a rare metal that is probably a big part of your life. Tantalum is used to make tantalum capacitors, which are an essential component of cameras, laptops, and cell phones. Not surprisingly, this makes tantalum highly valuable―so valuable, in fact, that a terrible conflict is being fought over it. About 80% of the world’s coltan is found in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Currently, the country is in the middle of a violent armed conflict, and most of its coltan mines are controlled by military groups. They extract the coltan and sell it to neighboring countries, using the money to buy more weapons. More and more people are buying electronic devices containing tantalum each year. To meet this demand, large amounts of coltan must be dug out of the earth. In many cases, small children are forced to work in the mines. Many farmers, whose fields have been destroyed in the fighting, are also employed by these mines. Although they receive a fair wage, __________. But humans aren’t the only ones being negatively affected. Wildlife in the area is also suffering. Endangered gorillas live in the area where coltan is mined, and they are often killed in the process of mining. The eastern region of the Congo was once home to thousands of eastern lowland gorillas; although the current population is unknown, it is believed to have been reduced by more than 50%. The conflict in the Congo is a complicated situation without an easy solution. However, businesses can improve the situation by refusing to buy any coltan coming from military groups. Moreover, within the Congo, they can work to support legitimate coltan mines, making sure the profits are used to benefit communities. Individuals can also help. By keeping our old electronic devices rather than buying new ones each year, we can reduce the demand for coltan. Then when we do upgrade to a newer model, we can recycle the old one or give it to charity instead of throwing it in the trash. Even the smallest efforts, when made by millions of consumers, can make a difference.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 사용하여 (영어로) 쓰시오.

그들은 무장한 군인에게 급여를 자주 빼앗긴다
[조건] (1) are, armed, by, often, of, pay, robbed, soldiers, their, they 를 모두 사용 (2) 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '~에게 …을 빼앗긴다'를 수동태(be + p.p.) + by(행위자)로 영작해요.
det.analysis:
주어는 they(그들, 복수)예요.

→ 복수 주어라 be동사 are를 쓰고, '빼앗기는' 수동이라 robbed를 이어 'are often robbed'로 만들어요(often은 be동사 뒤).

→ '급여를'은 of their pay, '무장 군인에게'는 행위자를 나타내는 by armed soldiers로 이어요.

→ 완성: they are often robbed of their pay by armed soldiers
det.tip: be robbed of + 물건 by + 사람 = ~에게 …을 빼앗기다 (수동태).

questions.wa: they are often robbed of their pay by armed soldiers
accept: they are often robbed of their pay by armed soldiers

questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (영어로)

[ and / are / buying / devices / electronic / more / More / people ] (8단어)

det.korean: '점점 더 많은 사람들이 전자기기를 사고 있다'를 More and more + 주어 + 현재진행으로 배열해요.
det.analysis:
'점점 더 많은'은 More and more로 시작해요.

→ 주어 people 뒤에 현재진행(are buying)을 써요.

→ 목적어 electronic devices(전자기기)를 마지막에 놓아요.

→ 완성: More and more people are buying electronic devices
det.tip: More and more + 주어 + are V-ing = 점점 더 많은 ~가 …하고 있다.

questions.wa: More and more people are buying electronic devices
accept: More and more people are buying electronic devices

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 사용하여 (영어로) 쓰시오.

그들은 합법적인 코발탄 광산을 지원하는 일을 할 수 있다
[조건] (1) can, coltan, legitimate, mines, support, they, to, work 를 모두 사용 (2) 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '~하는 일을 할 수 있다'를 can work + 목적의 to부정사(to support)로 영작해요.
det.analysis:
주어는 they(그들, 기업)예요.

→ '일을 할 수 있다'는 조동사 can + 동사원형 work로 써요.

→ '지원하려고/지원하는'은 목적을 나타내는 to부정사 to support로 이어요.

→ 목적어 '합법적인 코발탄 광산'은 legitimate coltan mines로 마무리해요.

→ 완성: they can work to support legitimate coltan mines
det.tip: work to support = 지원하는 일을 하다 (목적의 to부정사).

questions.wa: they can work to support legitimate coltan mines
accept: they can work to support legitimate coltan mines
